title: 并联 LC 陷波器：挡住 3 次谐波
statement: v_s = 220√2 cos(314t) + 40√2 cos(942t) V，经 L_1 = 40 mH 与 C_1 的并联支路向 R = 20 Ω 的负载供电。
选择 C_1，使负载电压 v_R 中**不含 3 次谐波**。求 C_1、此时负载电压的有效值，以及 L_1 中 3 次谐波电流的有效值。

questions.ask: 验证：v_R 中 3 次谐波的有效值 V_R3 = ?
questions.explain: 并联谐振的 LC 对 3 次谐波开路，负载中没有 3 次谐波电流，V_R3 = 0。

questions.ask: 负载电压的有效值 V_R = ?
L_1 中 3 次谐波电流的有效值 I_L3 = ?
questions.explain: 负载中没有 3 次谐波电流，3 次谐波电压 40 V 全部加在 LC 两端：I_L3 = 40/(3ωL_1) = 40/37.68 = 1.062 A，它在 L_1、C_1 之间来回流动。

hints: “不含 3 次谐波”意味着 3 次谐波电流在负载支路里为零——串在线路中的 LC 支路对 3 次谐波的阻抗必须是多少？
并联 LC 谐振时阻抗为无穷大：令谐振角频率等于 3ω。
基波时这个 LC 并联支路不谐振，它的阻抗是 jωL_1/(1 − ω²L_{1}C_1)，再用分压求负载电压。

en.title: A parallel LC trap that blocks the 3rd harmonic
statement: v_s = 220√2 cos(314t) + 40√2 cos(942t) V feeds a load R = 20 Ω through L_1 = 40 mH in parallel with C_1.
Choose C_1 so that the load voltage v_R contains **no 3rd harmonic**. Find C_1, the rms load voltage, and the rms 3rd-harmonic current in L_1.
hints: “No 3rd harmonic” means no 3rd-harmonic current in the load branch — what must the impedance of the LC in the line be at the 3rd harmonic?
A parallel LC at resonance has infinite impedance: make its resonant angular frequency equal to 3ω.
At the fundamental the LC is not resonant; its impedance is jωL_1/(1 − ω²L_{1}C_1). Then use the voltage divider.
solution: **1. Choose C_1.** To keep the 3rd-harmonic current out of the load, L_{1}C_1 must be in parallel resonance at 3ω (impedance → ∞): 9ω²L_{1}C_1 = 1, C_1 = 1/(9 × 314² × 0.04) = **28.17 µF**.
**2. 3rd harmonic.** The LC is open, I_R3 = 0, V_R3 = **0**; the whole 40 V 3rd-harmonic voltage is across the LC, I_L3 = 40/(3 × 314 × 0.04) = **1.062 A** (equal and opposite in C_1).
**4. The load voltage** is the fundamental only: v_R = 179.7√2 cos(314t − 35.24°) V, rms **179.7 V**.
**Check:** at 3ω, X_L = 3ωL_1 = 37.68 Ω and X_C = 1/(3ωC_1) = 37.68 Ω — equal, so it is indeed resonant.

questions.explain: In parallel resonance the LC impedance is infinite: 3ω = 1/√(L_{1}C_1), C_1 = 1/(9ω²L_1) = 1/(9 × 314² × 0.04) = 28.17 µF.

questions.ask: Check: rms value of the 3rd harmonic in v_R, V_R3 = ?
questions.explain: At the 3rd harmonic the resonant LC is an open circuit: no 3rd-harmonic current reaches the load, V_R3 = 0.
At the fundamental Z_LC = jωL_1/(1 − ω²L_{1}C_1) = j12.56/(8/9) = j14.13 Ω (inductive), V_R = 220 × 20/|20 + j14.13| = 179.7 V.

questions.ask: rms value of the 3rd-harmonic current in L_1, I_L3 = ?
questions.explain: No 3rd-harmonic current reaches the load, so the whole 40 V 3rd-harmonic voltage is across the LC: I_L3 = 40/(3ωL_1) = 40/37.68 = 1.062 A, circulating between L_1 and C_1.
